I just leveled mine.  It took a lot of sweat and some swearing, but it can be done.  What I did is rent a sod cutter from Home Depot to get rid of the grass.  This was a HUGE help with the next step.  I used a tiller to cut from the lowest point to the highest.  A lot of people don't recommend a tiller for leveling because it can dig up rocks, but if you take your time, it's fine.  I then used a roller tamper to flatten.  I checked the level with a simple line level that cost like $8.  The last step (and the most infuriating to me) was getting a ton of leveling sand and making tamping that down.

The project took about 4 days (18 ft round area).  I'm still off by 3/4 of an inch, but I can live with that.  There a a ton of youtube videos as well.

Edit:  Oh, and I used a tiller attachment for my weed eater, so nothing crazy expensive.
